## User Stories

### Display Sample Size Counter in Report Header
- **Story:** As a user, I want to see the total sample size displayed in the report header so that I can quickly understand the scope of the test data
- **Priority:** P0
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Sample size counter is visible in the report header
  - [ ] Counter shows the correct total number from the data
  - [ ] Counter position is properly aligned within header layout
  - [ ] Counter updates when data changes

### Implement Number Formatting for Sample Size
- **Story:** As a user, I want large sample size numbers to be formatted with appropriate separators so that they are easy to read
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Numbers > 999 show comma separators (e.g. 1,234)
  - [ ] Numbers > 999999 show appropriate notation (e.g. 1.2M)
  - [ ] Decimal places are handled appropriately
  - [ ] Zero values display as '0'
  - [ ] Invalid values show '--' or appropriate fallback

### Create Number Formatter Service
- **Story:** As a developer, I want a reusable number formatting service so that I can consistently format numerical values across the application
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Service provides method to format numbers with separators
  - [ ] Service handles edge cases (zero, null, undefined, NaN)
  - [ ] Service is unit tested
  - [ ] Service is documented with usage examples


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
